Method of Attack: Allows Discord chat participants to place calls to real-life phone numbers, enabling abusive calls including swatting and harassing calls
Uses generic phone numbers of various VoIP providers to place semi-anonymous calls
Allows purchase of phone call minutes using Bitcoin
Used for prank calls such as pizza orders and fake hotel reservations causing financial losses
Swatting attacks by sending emergency services to victims' houses
Attack Vector: Discord bot integration allowing calls from chat client
Bitcoin payments for call minutes enabling semi-anonymous calling
Use of generic VoIP phone numbers
